summary_en: Correction to June 26, 2026 buyback announcement: legal basis revised from Companies Act Article 165(3) / 156 to Article 459(1). Share count, yen limit, and execution terms remain unchanged from original filing.
title_en: Correction Notice: Partial Amendment to "Notice of Decision on Matters Relating to Treasury Stock Acquisition"
translation_en_brief: Japan System Techniques filed a correction notice on 30 June 2026 to amend the legal basis cited in its 26 June 2026 buyback authorization announcement. The original announcement incorrectly cited Companies Act Article 165(3) read in conjunction with Article 156. The correction clarifies that the authorization rests instead on Article 459(1) of the Companies Act and the company's articles of incorporation. All other terms of the buyback program—including the share count, yen ceiling, price limit, and execution window—remain as stated in the original 26 June announcement. This is a technical correction to the statutory reference and does not alter the substance or size of the buyback mandate.
